seal.statement: The home-lab CLI (scripts/lab/*) meets the repository's script guidelines: every scalar, state and name has a named constant owner (R06) and each outcome is decided at one boundary, so audit:guidelines - and the post-push static audits it belongs to - are green on main again. The CLI's command surface, its remote scripts and its inventory format are unchanged: this is a naming repair, not a behaviour change, and the witnesses prove both halves.

text: MEASURED ON MAIN (1c9f62017): run-static-audits.js reports 1/22 audits FAILED - audit:guidelines - and nothing else; the failing sub-audits are check-guideline-literals (197 new violations, all in scripts/lab: lagrange-lab 74, runner 44, probe 21, state 16, k3s 15, harness 14, process 13) and check-guideline-decision-boundaries (1: commandDoctor assigns failures from independent ifs). This is why repo-health has been red on main since the lab CLI landed (3b1fd7877) and why a merge of main into a quest branch cannot pass the pre-commit hook: its staged-file scan reads main lab files as new content. The rule (R06) exempts typeof strings, the empty string, 0/1/2, object keys, import sources, parseInt radix, and any literal inside a NON-exported const declaration, so the repair is naming: module-level const owners per file.

Named constant owners in all seven scripts/lab files (usage text, command/action/flag vocabulary, roles, ssh and kubectl argument vocabularies, remote shell and PowerShell script lines, arch/os alias tables, inventory paths and file mode, timeouts and ports, error texts); commandDoctor collects problems in one array and decides once; commandNode split into remove/probe/add with resolveNodePlatform; main dispatches through a handler table. No value, order, script text or exit code changed. Witness test/scripts/home-lab-cli-guidelines.test.js (both checkers zero over scripts/lab; usage and unknown-command refusal intact); evidence harness scripts/quest-evidence/home-lab-cli-guideline-debt.js with a fourth shell receipt running the post-push static audits. Sealed at metric 3 with the lab files at main; receipt now pass on all four, probe 0.

Independent verifier (subagent) round 1: REJECT on one behaviour change - COMMAND_HANDLERS as a plain object answered prototype-named commands (lab constructor / toString exited 0 silently; __proto__ and hasOwnProperty failed with the wrong message) where main refused them as unknown. Everything else confirmed: every moved literal same value and use site across the seven files; runtime equivalence proven by a stub harness recording every run/capture argv and stdin for 4 sample nodes x service on/off, k3s init/join/kubectl/labels, 9 probe sequences - 673 output lines byte-identical between main and branch; usage text byte-identical (772 bytes); local commands identical; audits 22/22 PASS reproduced; receipts digest-bound. Minor: the surface witness proved little of the byte-for-byte half; argv offset reused the flag-prefix constant; the receipt command rewrites the import-graph seal and owner-debt inventory, which belong in the scope.

Round-2 repairs from the rejection: dispatch looks up own keys only (Object.hasOwn), so prototype-named commands are refused as unknown exactly as on main; ARGV_COMMAND_OFFSET owns the argv slice; the surface witness now asserts the usage text byte for byte and refuses no-such-lab-command plus constructor, toString, hasOwnProperty and __proto__; the seal and inventory refresh the receipt command performs are in scope. Receipt regenerated: four receipts pass, probe 0.

Independent verifier (subagent) round 2 approve: the cached diff grew by exactly the ARGV_COMMAND_OFFSET constant, the own-key dispatch and its comment; constructor, toString, __proto__, hasOwnProperty, isPrototypeOf, valueOf and no-such each refused as Unknown lab command with exit 1; help byte-identical to main (772 bytes); witness 3/3 asserting the full usage text; both guideline audits 0 new; eslint clean; receipt regenerated after the edit with matching witness digest, four receipts pass; seal, inventory and receipt staged.
